verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships an installer ISO that the docs say you write to a USB stick, answer five questions, and get a finished desktop. The manual also covers dual-boot and unattended installs. Hands-on reports confirm the ISO install is uncomplicated and takes about 5 minutes, though one user's ISO install failed on a low-end Chromebook and they fell back to archinstall. missing for 10: documented step-by-step instructions or a first-party tool for writing the bootable USB, broader hardware-compatibility evidence for the ISO route (one reported failure on a Chromebook).
